entities.name: JobSeeker
entities.description: Represents an individual looking for jobs, containing personal details, contact information, and profile visibility settings.
entities.justification: The text explicitly defines a multi-level onboarding process for job seekers to collect personal details, address, and social media links.

entities.name: Employer
entities.description: Represents a company or organization offering jobs, containing company details, registration information, and verification status.
entities.justification: The text outlines a stepwise registration process for employers, collecting company details and managing verification status.

entities.name: UserAccount
entities.description: Represents the authentication and authorization credentials, roles, and status for any user of the platform.
entities.justification: The system manages user accounts, including enabling, disabling, deletion, recovery, and role-based access control.

entities.name: ExternalJobSite
entities.description: Represents a third-party job portal registered and integrated with the platform for job synchronization.
entities.justification: The system provides a registration and onboarding process for external job sites, issuing API keys and managing access.

value_objects.name: EducationRecord
value_objects.description: Represents a job seeker's educational background, including the degree obtained and the institution.

value_objects.name: ExperienceRecord
value_objects.description: Represents a job seeker's past work experience, including the company, role, and duration of employment.

value_objects.name: JobPreference
value_objects.description: Represents a job seeker's preferences for future employment, such as job type, industry, and salary expectations.

value_objects.name: Skill
value_objects.description: Represents a specific capability or expertise possessed by a job seeker, categorized as primary/secondary or soft/hard.

services.name: ResumeParsingService
services.description: Extracts structured information from uploaded resumes using AI to automatically populate job seeker profiles.

services.name: EmployerVerificationService
services.description: Verifies employer accounts automatically against government databases or manually by administrators.

services.name: AuthenticationService
services.description: Handles user login, multi-factor authentication, OTP delivery, and password policy enforcement.

aggregates.name: JobSeekerAggregate
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for a job seeker's profile, encompassing their personal details, education, experience, skills, and preferences.

aggregates.name: EmployerAggregate
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for an employer's profile, company details, and verification status.

aggregates.name: UserAccountAggregate
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for user authentication credentials, roles, and account lifecycle status.

domain_events.name: JobSeekerRegistered
domain_events.description: Triggered when a job seeker successfully completes the self-registration process.

domain_events.name: EmployerRegistered
domain_events.description: Triggered when an employer completes the stepwise registration process.

domain_events.name: EmployerVerified
domain_events.description: Triggered when an employer's account is successfully verified, granting them a Verified Employer badge.

domain_events.name: ProfileUpdated
domain_events.description: Triggered when a job seeker or employer edits and updates their profile information.

business_rules: The system SHALL require account activation through a one-time password (OTP) sent to the registered mobile number.
The system SHALL display a Verified Employer badge next to the names of verified companies to enhance trust.
The system SHALL enforce strong password policies with configurable parameters.
The system SHALL implement role-based access control to restrict access to features and data based on user roles.

entities.name: JobPosting
entities.description: Represents a job opportunity created by an employer or pushed by an external job site.
entities.justification: The system provides a structured form for employers to add new job opportunities and supports various statuses for job postings.

entities.name: JobCategory
entities.description: Represents standardized job categories used to classify and categorize job postings for accurate matching.
entities.justification: The system supports standardized job categories, skills, and qualifications to facilitate accurate matching.

entities.name: SavedSearch
entities.description: Represents a custom search filter saved by a job seeker for future use, with optional notifications.
entities.justification: The system supports saved searches with notification options for new matching jobs.

entities.name: InterestedList
entities.description: Represents a collection of job postings bookmarked and saved by a job seeker.
entities.justification: The system allows job seekers to bookmark and save jobs by adding them to an 'Interested List'.

value_objects.name: JobStatus
value_objects.description: Represents the current state of a job posting.

value_objects.name: ContractType
value_objects.description: Represents the type of employment contract for a job posting.

value_objects.name: WorkFormat
value_objects.description: Represents the work arrangement for a job posting.

value_objects.name: MatchScore
value_objects.description: Represents the calculated score indicating the compatibility between a job seeker and a job posting.

services.name: JobSearchService
services.description: Provides comprehensive search and advanced filtering capabilities for job seekers to find relevant opportunities.

services.name: JobMatchingService
services.description: Executes AI-driven matching algorithms to connect job seekers with relevant job opportunities based on skills, education, and behavior.

services.name: JobRecommendationService
services.description: Generates personalized job recommendations for job seekers and candidate recommendations for employers.

services.name: JobSynchronizationService
services.description: Handles real-time job data synchronization and updates via API with external job sites.

aggregates.name: JobPostingAggregate
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary around a job posting, ensuring its status, contract type, work format, and source platform are valid and synchronized.

domain_events.name: JobPosted
domain_events.description: Triggered when a new job opportunity is successfully created by an employer or pushed via API by an external site.

domain_events.name: JobStatusChanged
domain_events.description: Triggered when the status of a job posting changes (e.g., from active to paused or archived).

domain_events.name: JobExpired
domain_events.description: Triggered when a job posting reaches its application deadline or expiration date.

business_rules: JobPostingSchemaCompliance: All input data for job postings must comply with the Schema.org JobPosting standard for semantic compatibility and structured data integrity.
ExternalJobSourceAttribution: Jobs pushed from external platforms must be automatically tagged with the source platform's name and include a backlink to the original advertisement.
MinimumMatchThreshold: Job matches displayed to users must meet or exceed a minimum match threshold defined by administrators.

entities.name: JobMatch
entities.description: Represents the calculated match evaluation between a job seeker and a specific job posting. It holds the match score and ranking details.
entities.justification: The system calculates a match score and ranks job postings for seekers and candidates for employers.

entities.name: ParsedResume
entities.description: Represents the structured information extracted from an uploaded resume document using AI parsing technology. It contains standardized data that can be reviewed and corrected by the user.
entities.justification: The system extracts structured information from resumes, which job seekers can review and correct.

entities.name: Recommendation
entities.description: Represents a personalized suggestion of a job for a seeker or a candidate for an employer. It is generated based on profile data, preferences, and platform activity.
entities.justification: The system provides personalized job recommendations and candidate recommendations using collaborative and content-based filtering.

value_objects.name: MatchingCriteria
value_objects.description: An immutable set of parameters used to calculate a match score, such as skill overlap and experience range.

value_objects.name: ConfidenceScore
value_objects.description: An immutable score representing the AI's certainty regarding the accuracy of extracted resume information.

value_objects.name: SemanticAttribute
value_objects.description: A standardized skill or attribute identified via natural language processing from job descriptions or resumes.

services.name: ScoringAlgorithmService
services.description: A stateless service that calculates a vector-based match score between job seekers and job postings based on defined criteria.

services.name: ResumeParsingService
services.description: A stateless service that uses AI and NLP to extract and structure information from uploaded resume documents in multiple languages.

services.name: SemanticAnalysisService
services.description: A stateless service that performs natural language processing on job descriptions and resumes to understand semantic meaning beyond keyword matching.

services.name: RecommendationEngineService
services.description: A stateless service that uses collaborative and content-based filtering to generate personalized job and candidate recommendations.

aggregates.name: JobMatch
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary around the match evaluation, containing the match score and the criteria used to calculate it.

aggregates.name: ParsedResume
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary around the extracted resume data, containing the parsed details, semantic attributes, and confidence scores.

aggregates.name: Recommendation
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary around generated recommendations for users.

domain_events.name: ResumeParsed
domain_events.description: A past-tense fact indicating that a resume has been successfully processed and structured information has been extracted.

domain_events.name: MatchScoreCalculated
domain_events.description: A past-tense fact indicating that a match score between a candidate and a job has been generated.

business_rules: Minimum Match Threshold: A minimum match threshold (e.g., 60%) defined by administrators determines which job matches are displayed to users.
Match Score Calculation Criteria: Match scores must be calculated based on skill overlap, education match, training match, location match, experience range, and salary expectation range.
Automatic Candidate Filtering: Employers can set minimum qualification thresholds to automatically filter out candidates who do not meet the requirements.

entities.name: IntegrationPartner
entities.description: Represents an external job site or third-party portal registered to integrate with the platform.
entities.justification: The system provides a registration and onboarding process for external job sites to integrate securely.

entities.name: SubmissionLog
entities.description: Represents a recorded log entry of an API submission, including response codes, messages, and validation errors.
entities.justification: The system implements comprehensive error handling and response logging, granting external platforms access to view submission logs.

entities.name: JobSyncRecord
entities.description: Represents the synchronization state and details of a job posted or updated via the API by an external partner.
entities.justification: The system tracks the status of jobs posted via the API, including indicators for synced, failed, pending, and archived records.

value_objects.name: ApiKey
value_objects.description: An immutable token issued to a partner for secure API access, containing expiration and usage limits.

value_objects.name: SyncStatus
value_objects.description: Represents the current state of a synchronized job record, such as synced, failed, pending, or archived.

value_objects.name: DataMappingConfig
value_objects.description: Represents the configuration rules for mapping data schemas between external platforms and the system.

services.name: JobSynchronizationService
services.description: A stateless service that handles real-time job data synchronization using both pull and push integration models.

services.name: GovernmentIntegrationService
services.description: A stateless service that interacts with government and educational databases for data verification and enrichment.

aggregates.name: IntegrationPartnerAggregate
aggregates.description: Manages the lifecycle and configuration of an external partner, ensuring consistency of API keys and data mapping.

aggregates.name: JobSynchronizationAggregate
aggregates.description: Manages the consistency of job synchronization processes, tracking status and maintaining submission logs.

domain_events.name: PartnerOnboarded
domain_events.description: A past-tense fact indicating that an external job site has successfully registered and onboarded.

domain_events.name: JobPushedViaApi
domain_events.description: A past-tense fact indicating that a job opportunity was successfully submitted by an external platform via the API.

domain_events.name: JobSyncFailed
domain_events.description: A past-tense fact indicating that an error occurred during the job synchronization process.

business_rules: Each integration partner must be issued a unique API key or token with optional IP whitelisting and expiration management.
Jobs pushed via the API must be automatically tagged with the source platform's name and include a backlink to the original advertisement.
A unique job ID must be returned as a confirmation response after a job is successfully pushed via the API to enable accurate record-keeping.

entities.name: ReportTemplate
entities.description: Represents a reusable template defined by administrators with configurable parameters for generating reports.
entities.justification: Administrators can define report templates with configurable parameters.

entities.name: Report
entities.description: Represents a generated custom or periodic report that can be saved, exported, or distributed.
entities.justification: The system supports generating custom reports, saving them in a library, and exporting them in various formats.

entities.name: UserActivityLog
entities.description: Represents a recorded event of a user's action on the platform, such as profile views or job searches.
entities.justification: The system tracks and records user activities for analysis and reporting.

entities.name: PerformanceMetric
entities.description: Represents a recorded measurement of system health or matching algorithm performance.
entities.justification: The system monitors and reports on system performance metrics, including algorithm accuracy and technical response times.

entities.name: EmploymentStatistic
entities.description: Represents an aggregated metric or insight regarding the labor market, such as hiring rates or skill demand trends.
entities.justification: The system generates employment statistics and labor market insights from platform data.

value_objects.name: ReportFormat
value_objects.description: Defines the output format of a report, such as PDF, Excel, CSV, tabular data, or charts.

value_objects.name: ActivityType
value_objects.description: Defines the specific kind of user activity tracked, such as profile view, job search, or application.

value_objects.name: PerformanceMetricType
value_objects.description: Defines the specific performance indicator, such as response time, resource utilization, accuracy, or precision.

services.name: ReportGenerationService
services.description: Handles the creation, scheduling, and automated distribution of custom and periodic labor market reports.

services.name: ActivityTrackingService
services.description: Responsible for monitoring and recording user activities across the platform for analysis.

services.name: PerformanceMonitoringService
services.description: Monitors system health, tracks technical and algorithm metrics, and generates alerts for anomalies.

aggregates.name: ReportManagement
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for report templates, generated reports, and their access controls.

aggregates.name: ActivityTracking
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for user activity logs and their data retention policies.

aggregates.name: SystemMonitoring
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for performance metrics, system usage patterns, and alerts.

aggregates.name: LaborMarketAnalytics
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for employment statistics, trends, and labor market insights.

domain_events.name: ReportGenerated
domain_events.description: Emitted when a custom report or periodic labor market report is successfully generated.

domain_events.name: PerformanceAnomalyDetected
domain_events.description: Emitted when system performance metrics cross threshold limits, triggering an alert.

domain_events.name: UserActivityRecorded
domain_events.description: Emitted when a user performs a trackable action on the platform.

business_rules: ActivityLogRetentionPolicy: Data retention policies for activity logs must be implemented in compliance with regulations.
ReportAccessControl: Users can only view reports that are appropriate to their assigned role.

entities.name: AdministratorAccount
entities.description: Represents an administrator user with permissions to manage the platform, users, and settings.
entities.justification: Administrators have comprehensive user management capabilities, including approving, banning, and deactivating accounts.

entities.name: SystemSetting
entities.description: Represents a configurable parameter of the system defined and updated by authorized administrators.
entities.justification: Administrators can define and update system settings as needed.

entities.name: Taxonomy
entities.description: Represents system taxonomies and static reference files such as the skills list, occupations catalog, and training programs.
entities.justification: Administrators manage system taxonomies and static reference files.

entities.name: AuditLogEntry
entities.description: Represents a recorded administrative action maintained for security and accountability.
entities.justification: The system maintains an audit log of all administrative actions.

entities.name: NewsArticle
entities.description: Represents an article or announcement published in the content management system.
entities.justification: Administrators can create, edit, and publish articles and announcements with rich text and categorization.

entities.name: HelpContent
entities.description: Represents FAQ, laws, regulations, or help topics organized by topic and user role.
entities.justification: The system provides a comprehensive FAQ and help center that administrators can update.

entities.name: ReportTemplate
entities.description: Represents a defined template for generating custom reports with configurable parameters.
entities.justification: Administrators can define report templates with configurable parameters.

value_objects.name: TaxonomyType
value_objects.description: Defines the category of taxonomy, such as skills, occupations, or training programs.

value_objects.name: ReportFormat
value_objects.description: Defines the export format of a report, such as PDF, Excel, or CSV.

value_objects.name: SystemMetric
value_objects.description: Represents a performance or health metric of the system, such as response times or resource utilization.

services.name: UserAdministrationService
services.description: Handles viewing, approving, banning, deactivating user accounts, and resetting credentials.

services.name: TaxonomyManagementService
services.description: Handles managing system taxonomies and static reference files.

services.name: ContentManagementService
services.description: Handles creating, editing, and publishing news, updates, and help content.

services.name: ReportingAndAnalyticsService
services.description: Handles generating comprehensive statistics, custom reports, and monitoring system metrics.

aggregates.name: PlatformConfiguration
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for system settings and taxonomies.

aggregates.name: PlatformContent
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for CMS content like news and help articles.

aggregates.name: AdministrativeAudit
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for tracking administrative actions.

aggregates.name: Reporting
aggregates.description: Consistency boundary for report templates and generation.

domain_events.name: UserAccountStatusChanged
domain_events.description: Emitted when an administrator approves, bans, or deactivates a user account.

domain_events.name: SystemSettingUpdated
domain_events.description: Emitted when an authorized administrator defines or updates system settings.

domain_events.name: TaxonomyModified
domain_events.description: Emitted when an administrator manages system taxonomies.

domain_events.name: ContentPublished
domain_events.description: Emitted when an administrator publishes a news article or announcement.

business_rules: The system SHALL maintain an audit log of all administrative actions for security and accountability.
The system SHALL implement role-based access control to restrict access to features and data based on user roles.
